The '''Zybahhod system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Herios sector/Legends|Herios sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]].<ref name="Slice" /> It was home to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Zybahhod Yenyoni]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Design an Alien" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Zybahhod system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square T-15.<ref name="EAOC" />
